def unique_emails(emails):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for email in emails:
        normalized = email.strip().lower()
        if normalized and normalized not in seen:
            seen.add(normalized)
            result.append(normalized)
    result.sort()
    return result


def unique_tags(emails):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for email in emails:
        normalized = email.strip().lower()
        if normalized and normalized not in seen:
            seen.add(normalized)
            out.append(normalized)
    out.sort()
    return out
